newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme to buy Neozyme II at $45 per unit.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme to buy Neozyme II at $45 per unit.

text.p: Genzyme Corp said Monday it had signed a definitive agreement with Neozyme II Corp to make a tender offer to buy all outstanding Neozyme units at $45 per unit in cash.

Genzyme said each Neozyme unit consisted of one callable common share, one callable warrant to buy two common shares of Genzyme General Division and 0.135 common share of Genzyme Tissue Repair Division.

If the tender offer were successfully completed, Genzyme would make a "second-step" transaction and pay Neozyme II unit-holders who had not tendered their units $29 in cash for each share of callable common stock included in the untendered units, it said.
The callable warrants that had been included in the units acquired in the second-step transaction would remain outstanding, it added.
Genzyme said it expected the transaction to close later this year.
Neozyme II conducts research, development and clinical testing of products for the treatment of cystic fibrosis under contract with Genzyme, a biotechnology company.
